standards.scope: 15 changed security files; source inspection only

spec.scope: workspace gate, outbound policy and credential maintenance; source inspection only

findings.issue: Synthetic text could exempt real QCC failed-verification diagnostics without external locators
findings.fix: Server run context captures subjectVerificationProvider; real and unclassified appended subject assessments require an explicit internal model origin. Model-facing basis omits raw failureReason; QCC transport returns fixed codes.

findings.issue: Existing SSE connections remained live after logout or expiry
findings.fix: Session controllers close all owned stream wrappers, cancel upstream subscriptions and clear timers on logout or expiry.

limits: Review applies to the fixed committed range. Main exercised the fixes; reviewers did not run checks or independently re-review those subsequent edits. This is not a full repository security verdict.
